parameters.query: WITH binding AS (SELECT engineer_case_id FROM public.n8n_supportportal_engineer_slack_threads WHERE slack_team_id=$2 AND slack_channel_id=$3 AND slack_thread_ts=$4 AND active=TRUE), inserted AS (INSERT INTO public.n8n_supportportal_engineer_slack_inbound_events(inbound_id,inbound_kind,engineer_case_id,slack_user_id) SELECT $1,'app_mention',engineer_case_id,$5 FROM binding ON CONFLICT(inbound_id) DO NOTHING RETURNING engineer_case_id) SELECT COALESCE((SELECT engineer_case_id FROM inserted),'') engineer_case_id,EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM inserted) forward;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [$('Verify And Filter Mention').first().json.event_id,$('Verify And Filter Mention').first().json.team_id,$('Verify And Filter Mention').first().json.channel_id,$('Verify And Filter Mention').first().json.thread_ts,$('Verify And Filter Mention').first().json.slack_user_id] }}

parameters.body: ={{ JSON.stringify({schema_version:1,event_id:$('Verify And Filter Mention').first().json.event_id,engineer_case_id:$json.engineer_case_id,slack_user_id:$('Verify And Filter Mention').first().json.slack_user_id,text:$('Verify And Filter Mention').first().json.text,occurred_at:$('Verify And Filter Mention').first().json.occurred_at}) }}
